experience.desc: Led the design and development of scalable iOS applications for the banking and communications sectors using Swift, SwiftUI, and modern architecture patterns. Managed and mentored a team of 5-6 engineers while remaining hands-on in development, delivered a SwiftUI module used by over 1 million users with a 30% performance improvement, reduced production crashes through proactive monitoring and fixes, and streamlined releases through CI/CD automation and feature flag-driven deployment strategies.

As an iOS Team Lead, I built and mentored a team of 5 engineers, delivered 5+ consumer mobile apps, and helped grow user engagement by 15% through data-driven product improvements. I also introduced CI/CD pipelines, Firebase Analytics, A/B testing, and scalable API integrations to support reliable and efficient app delivery.

Developed and maintained multiple iOS applications using Swift and Objective-C, applying MVVM architecture and SOLID principles to build scalable and maintainable solutions. Successfully reduced production crash rates by up to 90%, modernized legacy code through Objective-C to Swift migration, and created reusable UI components aligned with Apple Human Interface Guidelines to deliver high-quality user experiences.

experience.role: Sr. Executive Quality Assurance / Sr. Executive Developer

Started my iOS development career by contributing to multiple production applications, applying iOS best practices to improve app stability and user experience.
